{"metadata":{"description":"让 DSH 智能体用你选定的语言思考与回复：三档强度、设置面板、侧栏快速切换。零依赖、零构建。","id":"gh:1424475406","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-language-guard","slug":"58fly/dsh-language-guard","topics":["chinese","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","i18n","language","localization","prompt-engineering"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"让 DSH 智能体用你选定的语言思考与回复：三档强度、设置面板、侧栏快速切换。零依赖、零构建。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Language Guard (dsh-language-guard)"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> Make the DSH agent think and answer in the language you choose — Simplified Chinese by default, th"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ree strength levels, effective on the next message, zero dependencies, no build step."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Why you need it"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The DSH system prompt is assembled from many sections: identity, plan policy, team policy, **tool de"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"scriptions**, deliverable references, deployment persona. The largest block by far is the tool docum"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"entation — written in English, and placed in the middle of the prompt."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Measured on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 (everything after order 50): **98.1% of the characters and 99.8% of the A"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"SCII** come from English tool documentation, and 5.7K–14K characters separate the opening section fr"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"om the closing one. The model reads overwhelmingly English tokens, and so it drifts:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- The first few turns stay in your language;
- as soon as it starts chaining tool calls, reading lon"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"g files, or reasoning at length, the reasoning slides back into English;
- nothing in your settings "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"changed — the conversation simply got longer."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"A single "please answer in Chinese" line at the very top of the system prompt is enough for a short "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"session. It is not enough for a long one, because that line sits tens of thousands of characters awa"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"y from the place that actually influences the model (the tool documentation)."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"This plugin puts a constraint in **three places**: at the very start, right after the tool documenta"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"tion, and at the very end. The default level (Strong) costs roughly 146 extra characters per request"},{"id":"p10s3","text":" and buys one restatement positioned after the English tool docs."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Three resident system-prompt sections, registered through `ctx.systemPrompt.section()`, never dispos"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ed, switching level only switches their text:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Section name | Order | Position | B | C | D |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| `language-guard:head` | `-2000` | Very first, before `harness:identity` (`-1000`) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"`language-guard:mid` | `5100` | After all tool docs (`tools:sdk`, `5000`), before deliverable refere"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"nces (`9000`) | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |
| `language-guard:tail` | `11200` | Very last, after `deployment:persona"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"-suffix` (`10200`) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The constraint covers **four language channels** (the fourth landed in 0.3.0):"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Channel | Where the constraint lives | Coverage |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Internal reasoning (reasoning / thinking) | `head` + `tail` | every level |
| User-facing reply te"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"xt | `head` + `mid` + `tail` | every level |
| Plans, todos, reviews, subagent briefs | `head` | eve"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ry level |
| **Tool-call `description` parameter** (the card title of `run_code` in PTC mode) | `hea"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"d` + `mid` | every level (`mid` exists only at C / D, hence the extra line in `head`) |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The `mid` order is deliberately `5100` and not `5000`: `tools:sdk` is exactly `5000`, and sections w"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ith equal order fall back to comparing names, which would sort `language-guard:mid` **before** `tool"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"s:sdk` — the restatement would no longer come after the tool docs."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Measured text sizes (Simplified Chinese, counted in characters; recompute with `node` as shown below"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"asured text sizes (Simplified Chinese, counted in characters; recompute with `node` as shown below):"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Text | Characters | When it is present |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| head | 883 | every request |
| mid | 146 | every request at C / D |
| tail | 139 | every request |"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"
| periodic reminder | 99 | once every N turns at D |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"So the steady cost per step is **1022 characters at B and 1168 at C** — tiny compared to the English"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" tool documentation it counteracts."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The opening section (head), verbatim, as it looks with the default `targetLanguage: "zh-CN"` (recomp"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ute with `node -e 'import("./lib/text.js").then(m=>console.log(m.headText({language:"zh-CN"})))'`):"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"This plugin is published to the **npm registry** (`dsh-language-guard`), and it can also be installe"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"d straight from its GitHub repository. Both routes deliver byte-identical content: the same 16 files"},{"id":"p27s3","text":" straight from its GitHub repository. Both routes deliver byte-identical content: the same 16 files."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### Seeing what it resolved to"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"The first control group in the settings card is the language mode; with "Auto" selected it spells ou"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"t the current result and its source right below:"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"- **The constraint wording is fixed Simplified Chinese.** Only the language name and code are substi"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"tuted, so with `targetLanguage: "en"` the injected text reads "…一律使用English（语言代码 en）". Models handle"},{"id":"p34s3","text":" this fine, but the prose is not localized. Localizing the templates is a future change.
- **The Per"},{"id":"p34s4","text":"iodic reminder is visible in the chat UI**, collapsed into one line reading "上下文注入 · language-guard "},{"id":"p34s5","text":"· 语言自检". The English identifier `language-guard` **cannot be hidden** — the client renders `source.k"},{"id":"p34s6","text":"ind` verbatim as the injection label, exactly as it does for the official `agent-instructions` and `"},{"id":"p34s7","text":"skill-invocation`. Localizing it would require a custom `conversation.chat.node` renderer for the co"},{"id":"p34s8","text":"ntext node; the first release does not do that.
- **The Client half has no turn counter**, so the pa"},{"id":"p34s9","text":"nel cannot show "the next injection lands on turn X".
- **The quick switch menu lists five presets p"},{"id":"p34s10","text":"lus one "Custom" entry.** Custom BCP-47 tags must be typed into the settings field; in Manual mode w"},{"id":"p34s11","text":"ith a value outside the presets, the menu gains a checked "Custom: <language>" entry so that six unc"},{"id":"p34s12","text":"hecked rows no longer look like "nothing was ever set". The menu cannot enumerate arbitrary tags — s"},{"id":"p34s13","text":"witching to another custom value still goes through the settings field.
- **Absolute locking, no per"},{"id":"p34s14","text":"-turn escape hatch.** A deliberate trade-off: the plugin is "set once, applies throughout", so a tur"},{"id":"p34s15","text":"n-level instruction such as "answer in English *this once*" does **not** switch it away — change the"},{"id":"p34s16","text":" setting or use `/language` instead. That is the opposite stance from "switch per turn"; if you need"},{"id":"p34s17","text":" per-turn switching, this plugin is the wrong tool.
- **It cannot detect whether `dsh-context` is in"},{"id":"p34s18","text":"stalled**, so the hint is permanent (see above).
- **Periodic never wakes an idle session.** `agent/"},{"id":"p34s19","text":"pre-step` only fires while a turn is running, so no message means no reminder — a language guard sho"},{"id":"p34s20","text":"uld not generate conversation on its own.
